services.name: DiagTrack
services.assessment: Sends diagnostic and usage data to Microsoft.
services.recommendation: Not needed for gaming. Setting it to Manual reduces background activity.

services.name: dmwappushservice
services.assessment: Routes WAP push messages for device management and telemetry.
services.recommendation: Can be set to Manual on PCs that are not managed by an organisation.

services.name: SysMain
services.assessment: Preloads frequently used applications into memory.
services.recommendation: Helpful on hard disks. On SSD-only systems with high disk activity it can be set to Manual; otherwise leave it.

services.name: WSearch
services.assessment: Indexes files for Start menu and Explorer search.
services.recommendation: Set to Manual only if you rarely use Windows search; searches will be slower.

services.name: Spooler
services.recommendation: If you never print, Disabled also reduces attack surface. Re-enable before printing.

services.name: MapsBroker
services.assessment: Downloaded Maps Manager for the Maps app.
services.recommendation: Can be set to Manual if you do not use offline maps.

services.name: RetailDemo
services.assessment: Retail demo mode for store display PCs.

services.name: XblAuthManager
services.recommendation: Required for Xbox app and Game Pass games. Keep it.

services.name: XblGameSave
services.recommendation: Required for Game Pass cloud saves. Keep it.

services.name: XboxNetApiSvc
services.recommendation: Required for Xbox multiplayer features. Keep it.

services.name: XboxGipSvc
services.recommendation: Required for Xbox controllers. Keep it.

services.name: GamingServices
services.recommendation: Required for PC Game Pass games. Keep it.

services.name: wuauserv
services.recommendation: Security critical. STORM OS never changes it; Game Mode already defers updates while you play.

services.name: WinDefend
services.recommendation: Security critical. STORM OS never changes it.

services.name: mpssvc
services.recommendation: Security critical. STORM OS never changes it.

services.name: BFE
services.recommendation: Security critical. STORM OS never changes it.
